fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Four cities and four reps behind one page

One page carries every stop of the Tallgrass Analytics breakfast roadshow, and a visitor picks a city on the form. The registration lands in HubSpot with that city's rep as owner, and the rep gets a direct message in Slack. Austin sign-ups go to Dana Whitfield.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { industryConference: "Build a registration page for Ridgeline's two-day operations summit in Portland. Show the dates, the venue address with a directions link, and the agenda for each day. Ask every attendee for a name, a work email, and one dietary need. Seventy-two hours before doors open, email our venue coordinator the lunch count for the first day, with each dietary type listed and counted.", communityMarket: "My team runs the Harbor Street Night Market. Build a page where people RSVP for free with a name and an email. On the night, our volunteers need a check-in screen for tablets: search a name, tap Check In and save the time. Give the organizers a dashboard with arrivals so far against total RSVPs and a bar for each hour.", inviteOnlyParty: "Build a private RSVP page for my studio's 10th anniversary party. Each invited guest answers yes or no and can bring one guest. Count every plus-one in the headcount and show me the total against our venue's limit of 150 people. Close the form when the headcount reaches 150 and show a short note that the party is full.", cityRoadshow: "Build one landing page for our breakfast roadshow across four cities, with a city picker on the form. Send each registration to HubSpot as a contact, set the owner to the rep for that city and send that rep a direct message in Slack. Austin goes to Dana Whitfield. Email each registrant the address of their city's venue." };
